content: For the relation encoder, we firstly join all items in the n-ary relation $M$ into a sequence. Then we only take answer position embedding as an extra feature for the sequence: $\mathbf {x}_i^m= [\mathbf {w}_i; \mathbf {a}_i]$. Similarly, we take another bidirectional LSTMs to encode the relation sequence and derive the corresponding contextualized representation $(\mathbf {h}^{m}_1, \mathbf {h}^{m}_2, ..., \mathbf {h}^{m}_n)$.
